name: paper-engineering-assistant
description: Local-first desktop assistant for CS paper engineering with reviewer-aligned evidence workflows.

scripts.backend:dev:prisma:setup: pnpm env:dev:db-url:init && pnpm env:dev:compile && pnpm db:dev:migrate
scripts.db:dev:migrate: set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.env:dev:compile: python3 -B -S env/scripts/env_localctl.py compile --root . --env dev --runtime-target local --workload api --out artifacts/env-local/dev-compile.md
scripts.env:dev:db-url:init: mkdir -p env/.secrets-store/dev && if [ ! -f env/.secrets-store/dev/database_url ]; then printf 'postgresql://%s@127.0.0.1:5432/postgres?schema=my_researcher_dev\n' "${USER:-postgres}" > env/.secrets-store/dev/database_url; fi && chmod 600 env/.secrets-store/dev/database_url
scripts.env:dev:doctor: python3 -B -S env/scripts/env_localctl.py doctor --root . --env dev --runtime-target local --workload api --out artifacts/env-local/dev-doctor.md
scripts.paper-implementation:provider-canary: cd apps/backend && BACKEND_TEST_PRESERVE_REAL_ENV=1 T114_TRACE_INTEGRITY_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 T114_P1_CLAIM_BOUNDARY_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 T114_P1_DOSSIER_READINESS_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 T114_RESULT_ANALYSIS_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 T114_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 T114_EXPERIMENT_CRITIQUE_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 T114_ROUTE_ARCHITECTURE_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 T114_ROUTE_SKEPTIC_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 T114_VALIDATION_CYCLE_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 T114_FEASIBILITY_PLANNING_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 T114_CROSS_BOARD_SYNTHESIS_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 T114_EVIDENCE_BOARD_CURATION_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 T114_MOTIVE_DECOMPOSITION_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 T114_MOTIVE_EVOLUTION_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 node --env-file=../../.env.local --test --loader ts-node/esm src/routes/paper-implementation-runtime-routes.integration.test.ts
scripts.paper-implementation:provider-fail-close: cd apps/backend && BACKEND_TEST_PRESERVE_REAL_ENV=1 T114_PROVIDER_FAIL_CLOSED_CANARY_LIVE=1 node --env-file=../../.env.local --test --loader ts-node/esm src/routes/paper-implementation-runtime-routes.integration.test.ts
scripts.paper-implementation:runtime-prisma-smok: cd apps/backend && BACKEND_TEST_PRESERVE_REAL_ENV=1 T114_RUNTIME_PRISMA_SMOKE=1 PAPER_IMPLEMENTATION_REPOSITORY=prisma AUTO_PULL_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=false node --env-file=../../.env.local --test --loader ts-node/esm src/routes/paper-implementation-runtime-routes.integration.test.ts
scripts.topic-selection:v1b-provider-canary: cd apps/backend && BACKEND_TEST_PRESERVE_REAL_ENV=1 T112_V1B_N4_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 T112_V1B_N6_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 T112_V1B_N8_PROVIDER_CANARY_LIVE=1 node --env-file=../../.env.local --test --loader ts-node/esm src/services/topic-selection-provider-canary-service.unit.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @paper-engineering-assistant/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @paper-engineering-assistant/backend typecheck && node ci/scripts/db-context-constraints.mjs check && pnpm --filter @paper-engineering-assistant/desktop typecheck
